_comment: Source of truth for the photo gallery and the hero portrait.
Add a photo: drop the file into the source folder (default: ../photo, i.e. OUTSIDE this repo),
add an entry below, then run:  python3 tools/process_photos.py
The script resizes, strips ALL metadata (including GPS), writes WebP + JPEG into
assets/img/gallery/, and rewrites the gallery and portrait blocks inside index.html.
Originals are never copied into the repo.
Captions and alt text are translated in assets/js/i18n.js — add new strings there too.

portrait._note: Wide scene, so it needs framing. focusX/focusY place the centre of the crop as a fraction of the image; zoom tightens in from the largest possible square. Lower zoom = wider = more sky.
